# qwen38-27b-strix-halo

> Qwen 3.8 27B serving on a $1,400 AMD Strix Halo mini-PC: the frozen
> optimal config, measured speed sheet, needle-exact retrieval at the 262k
> ceiling, vision fixed and validated upstream, and the Delegation Card.

## What this is
- The complete measured serving story for a local 27B model on consumer
  hardware: config, speed, memory, quality, failure modes, fix trail.
- Every number ships with its methodology and raw logs.
- The machine that earned the Delegation Card (certified walk-away floors).

## Key facts
- $1,400 GMKtec EVO-X2 (AMD Strix Halo, 64GB unified, ROCm)
- Qwen3.8-27B Q4_K_XL + q4_0 KV + mirror spec + 262,144 ctx
- Needle-exact retrieval: 13/13 both seeds at the native ceiling
- Vision: 6/6 real-UI screenshots; upstream fix validated on our silicon
- Speed sheet with labeled regimes; time-per-task doctrine
